jobs.title: Senior Social Media Manager
jobs.description:
**Welcome to the Agentic Commerce Era**
=======================================

At Commerce, our mission is to empower businesses to innovate, grow, and thrive with our open, AI-driven commerce ecosystem. As the parent company of BigCommerce , Feedonomics , and Makeswift , we connect the tools and systems that power growth, enabling businesses to unlock the full potential of their data, deliver seamless and personalized experiences across every channel, and adapt swiftly to an ever-changing market. We believe in harnessing AI responsibly to unlock new possibilities, and we’re looking for individuals who use it intentionally to solve problems, accelerate outcomes, and expand what’s possible in their role. Our purpose is to help businesses confidently solve complex commerce challenges so they can build smarter, adapt faster, and grow on their own terms. If you want to be part of a team of bold builders, sharp thinkers, and technical trailblazers who shape the future of commerce, this is the place for you.

The **Senior Social Media Manager** owns the organic social media across our family of brands — Commerce, BigCommerce, Feedonomics, and Makeswift — plus social support for select members of our leadership team.

  

This is an ownership role, not a support role. It sets the strategy, builds the calendar, makes the content, publishes it, and answers for the numbers. Partners with Creative, PR, Demand Gen, Content, and Product Marketing teams, but it shapes and owns the Social Media program.

  

The person who does well here is a strategist who is also fast with their hands. They can build a quarter-long narrative for our brands, and can also turn a keynote clip into a live post the same afternoon without waiting on anyone.

  

**What You'll Do**
------------------

  

**Strategy And Planning**

* Own a documented organic social strategy for each brand, with a clear point of view on what each channel is for and which audiences it serves (customers, prospects, partners, analysts, candidates, employees).
* Maintain a rolling four-week content calendar covering every brand and channel, extended and refreshed weekly, visible to stakeholders.
* Set and defend the content mix: executive video, customer stories, product and platform news, events, recruiting, and reactive commentary.
* Bring a quarterly plan to leadership that connects social activity to brand, demand, and communications goals.
Work alongside a new social selling agency we will deploy  

  

**Content Creation And Publishing**

* Write and edit for social: captions, threads, short-form video scripts, and executive posts that hold each brand's distinct voice.
* Produce your own assets. Use Canva, CapCut, or similar to make images and cut short-form video so that routine content ships without waiting on a design queue. You'll partner with Design on higher-craft, campaign-level work and on reusable templates for recurring post types.
* Build repeatable content series and consistent visual formats rather than one-off posts.
* Publish across LinkedIn, X, Instagram, Facebook, and YouTube, adapting format and framing to each platform rather than cross-posting. You will have a point of view on what content should go on each channel.
* Monitor and evaluate additional or emerging channels and make recommendations about where we should activate.

**Speed On Moments that Matter**

* For events, launches, and known milestones, have content and creative prepared in advance so posts can happen in the moment.
* Cover live moments such as keynotes, events, internal all-hands, offsites, etc. yourself and capture raw video and photos to capitalize on those moments and momentum quickly.
* Monitor news, industry reports, and cultural moments for places our brands and executives can credibly add something.

**Executive And Employee Social**

* Draft, schedule, and manage social content for select senior leaders.
* Identify commentary opportunities where an executive perspective lands better than a brand post.
* Run the employee advocacy program end to end: recruit participants, supply content people actually want to share, and grow participation.

**Measurement**

* Own the numbers. Define the KPIs that matter per channel and per brand, and report monthly on what performed, what didn't, and what you're changing as a result.
* Identify top-performing posts each month and use format testing to make deliberate decisions rather than posting on habit. More volume is not the goal; engagement and impact are.
* Use Sprout Social, Google Analytics, and potentially additional tools to inform reporting.

**Brand Safety And Standards**

* Every post gets a human read for accuracy, relevance, messaging alignment, and voice before it goes out. Attention detail is a must.
Uphold brand standards across all social touchpoints, monitor for social media policy issues, and partner with PR and Community on crisis response.  

  

**Who You Are**

* 5+ years in social media strategy and content creation, in-house or agency, with B2B tech experience preferred.
* You've owned a program, not just a queue. You've set the agenda somewhere rather than executing someone else's calendar.
* You are genuinely online. You understand LinkedIn, X, Instagram, and YouTube as distinct cultures, not as distribution endpoints, and you know how audiences get built.
* A strong, versatile writer who can move between brand voice and executive voice without flattening either.
* Hands-on with short-form video and design tooling such as CapCut, Premiere, DaVinci, Canva, or equivalent. You can shoot on a phone and cut something good.
* Comfortable with analytics and honest about them. You can walk into a room, say a campaign underperformed, and explain what you're doing differently.
* Organized under real load. Multiple brands, multiple calendars, competing stakeholders, and you don't lose the thread.
* Proactive by default. You surface the problem and the proposed fix before someone else notice

Avalon Healthcare Solutions is the nation’s leader in diagnostic intelligence, uniquely focused on transforming the role of diagnostic testing across the healthcare ecosystem. Our proprietary Diagnostic Insights Platform delivers evidence-based policies, curated lab networks, and real-time analytics that simplify complex diagnostics, accelerate innovation adoption, and optimize diagnostic investments.

Supporting over 30 health plans and 100 million members nationwide, Avalon partners with payers and providers to ensure diagnostic testing is performed appropriately, efficiently, and at the right time. Our flexible solutions span routine and genetic testing management, automated adherence, and end-to-end diagnostics support—driving measurable value, reduced waste, and improved clinical outcomes.

With unmatched scientific rigor, deep clinical expertise, and a performance-based model, Avalon is redefining how diagnostics power personalized care and healthcare value. You will be part of a team that shapes a new market and business. Most importantly, you will help Avalon to achieve its mission and improve clinical outcomes and health care affordability for the people we serve.

For more information about Avalon, please visit www.avalonhcs.com.

Avalon Healthcare Solutions is an Equal Opportunity Employer - Vet/Disability.

This position description is subject to change at any time. As determined by the company based upon business needs, an employee in this position may be required to perform duties and take responsibility for work other than as described in this document.

**About the Product Marketing Manager Position:**

The Product Marketing Manager is a role that adds dedicated capacity to Avalon's Product Marketing & Communication team. Reporting to the SVP, Product Marketing & Communications, this role supports end-to-end go-to-market execution, positioning and messaging, competitive and market intelligence, and sales enablement across Avalon's growing Diagnostic Intelligence cross continuum product portfolio (RTM, LVM, RRM, SRX, Genetics, and future launches).

The ideal candidate brings a minimum of 5 years of product marketing experience gained on the vendor/commercialization side of healthcare IT — developing go-to-market strategy, positioning, and launch materials for solutions sold into health plans, providers, TPAs/brokers, or employers. Experience gained solely within a health plan's internal product organization does not meet this requirement.

*This position is eligible for remote work, but quarterly travel to Avalon's corporate office in Tampa, Florida, will be required in addition to travel to industry conferences, Avalon-hosted events, client and prospect visits, and advisory councils.*

**Product Marketing Manager – Essential Functions and Responsibilities:**

* Develop and execute product go-to-market strategies for new solutions, and support product launch planning and execution.

Sprinto is an **Autonomous Trust Platform** that centralizes trust requirements across **security frameworks, vendors, and customers.**

Sprinto autonomously executes tasks needed to maintain trust across compliance, audits, risk management, vendor risk, privacy, and AI governance, enabling organizations to maintain a strong, reliable trust posture without draining operational bandwidth and resources on repetitive tasks.

Backed by top-tier investors such as Accel, Elevation, and Blume Ventures, we’ve **raised** **$31.8M** in funding to fuel our mission. Trusted by over **4,000 organizations across 75 countries**, Sprinto helps organizations stay audit-ready, manage real-time risks, and scale fearlessly. With **300+ native integrations** and AI-driven automation, Sprinto supports **200+ global security standards natively**, including SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, HIPAA, PCI-DSS, and more. Sprinto's extensible architecture enables organizations to build and support an infinite number of custom integrations and frameworks.

**Founded in 2020** by second-time founders Girish Redekar and Raghuveer Kancherla, Sprinto powers compliance for organizations like Whatfix, Encora, Anaconda, Whatnot, Ultrahuman, WeWork, Everstage, AI Foundation, HackerRank, and many more.

### **Life as a Sprinter -**

Nobody succeeds at Sprinto by staying in their lane.

We are organized around problems, not job titles. Sprinters take ownership beyond their role, solve hard problems, and care deeply about the impact they create. If something can be improved, fixed, or built, we don't wait for permission; we step in.

Being remote means we rely less on proximity and more on trust. We write things down, communicate openly, and move quickly because great teams aren't built by sitting together, they're built by pulling in the same direction.

We believe progress beats perfection, feedback is a gift, and doing the right thing matters, even when nobody is watching.

And while we move with urgency, we never move alone.

### **The mission -**

Some of our most valuable customer conversations begin in a room: a CISO dinner, a founder meetup, a practitioner roundtable. Your mission is to turn those conversations into a predictable, growing source of pipeline for Sprinto.

* **Grow communities and executive relationships.** Own GRC Hub and Secure Circle, creating programming that builds membership, engagement, and pipeline. Bring the right buyers into the room and turn members into speakers, hosts, and advocates.
* **Lead the team and build repeatable systems.** Coach three regional field marketers, own hiring and headcount planning, and build reusable playbooks for execution and reporting. Manage vendors and agencies, and partner with Product Marketing, Marketing Operations, and Finance to keep programs consistent and well-run.
* **Experiment and turn learning into action.** Test new markets, formats, gifting, and activations with clear hypotheses and budget caps. Use AI to improve research, targeting, content, and reporting, and turn successful experiments into programs the team can repeat.

### **The kind of builder we're looking for -**

* **You’ve built and led field marketing teams.** You bring 8–12 years in B2B marketing, including 5+ in SaaS field or regional marketing and 3+ managing field marketers, ideally across regions.
* **You can connect programs to commercial outcomes.** You’ve owned multi-region budgets and pipeline targets, can demonstrate program ROI, and are comfortable building your own analysis in HubSpot.

jobs.description:
**About us**Hipster Inc is a Singapore-based technology company with teams in Singapore and India. We build software for enterprise and government clients, from cloud platforms to AI-powered systems.

We also built Voncierge, our own AI and video customer-service platform. Visitors get help through QR codes, web, app or kiosks, answered by an AI avatar or a live agent over video. Voncierge is live at Changi Airport and Jewel Changi, and we’re in conversations with airports across Asia and North America.

**The role**This is our first senior marketing hire. You’ll own marketing across both businesses, with 60:40 split on Voncierge and Hipster. There’s no playbook waiting for you: you’ll set the strategy, decide where the budget goes, and run it. You’ll report to the CEO and lead a small growth team (a growth manager and an intern).

This is a player-coach role. You’ll set the positioning and also write and ship the campaigns yourself.

**What you’ll own**

* Positioning and messaging for both brands, and how they strengthen each other
* Pipeline: qualified meetings for our business development team, against a target you help set
* Account-based campaigns into airports, government agencies and large enterprises
* Case studies, content and thought leadership that build trust in long sales cycles
* Events and trade shows, from pre-event outreach to post-event follow-up
* Marketing support for proposals and tenders, working with our India-based proposals team
* Our marketing tools (LinkedIn, Apollo, website, CRM) and reporting on what’s working
* Budget, agencies and freelancers

**In your first 90 days**

* Write the marketing plan for both brands and agree targets with the CEO
* Launch your first account-based campaign into a priority sector
* Set up monthly reporting on marketing-sourced pipeline

**You’re a fit if you have**

* 5+ years in B2B marketing, including building marketing from scratch at a company under ~100 people
* A track record of owning a pipeline or revenue number, and you can tell us what it was
* Experience with long, complex sales cycles: enterprise, government or tenders
* Strong writing: you can produce a sharp case study or LinkedIn post yourself
* Comfort using AI tools to get more done with a small team
* The discipline to work independently and remotely, with clear written communication

**Nice to have**

* Background in conversational AI, customer-experience tech, SaaS or IT services
* Exposure to airports, travel or facilities management
* Experience marketing across APAC and North America

**This probably isn’t for you if** you’re used to large budgets and big teams, and you prefer directing agencies to doing the work yourself.

**What we offer**

* Real ownership: your plan, your budget, your calls
* A direct line to the CEO and a voice in company strategy
* Remote work within APAC time zones (GMT+5:30 to GMT+8)
* A product already live at one of the world’s leading airports, so you’re marketing something real
* Room to build and lead a bigger team as we grow

**How to apply**Send your CV with a few lines on one time you built a pipeline from zero: what you did and what the result was. We read these before CVs.

Hiring: Newsletter & Digital Marketing Executive (Founding Team)

**k’LAH’ng Digest | Klang Valley, Malaysia**

**Employment type:** Initial 3-month contract, with potential for long-term employment employee does work diligently.  
**Compensation:** 5% commission for every sponsorship successfully secured  
**Work arrangement:** To be discussed

**About k’LAH’ng Digest**

k’LAH’ng Digest is an upcoming newsletter based in Malaysia covering the latest news, happenings, events, businesses and community stories around Klang Valley. Our goal is to help people stay connected to what is happening around them through a newsletter that is informative, engaging and enjoyable to read.

We’re a startup at the early stages of building our brand, audience and sponsorship opportunities. We’re looking for a creative, self-motivated person who wants to be part of the journey from the beginning and help turn the project into a sustainable media brand.

**The Role**

We’re looking for someone who can wear multiple hats: **newsletter writer, social media content creator and digital marketer**.

You’ll be responsible for turning local stories and research into engaging newsletters, repurposing newsletter content for social media, creating advertisements, and helping attract sponsors and grow our audience.

This role is suited to someone who enjoys writing, has an eye for design, understands social media and knows how to create content that gets people's attention.

**Key Responsibilities**

1. Newsletter Writing & Editing

* Research and write engaging local newsletters for distribution every **Monday and Thursday** through Kit.
* Find relevant news, community stories, local events, lifestyle updates and interesting happenings around Klang Valley.
* Turn research into clear, accurate and original content that is easy and enjoyable to read.
* Write compelling headlines, introductions and calls to action.
* Proofread and edit newsletters before publication, ensuring accuracy, consistency and a friendly brand voice.
* Incorporate sponsored content into newsletters when sponsorships are secured.

2. Organic Social Media Content

* Create and publish **2–3 organic posts per week** on Facebook and/or Instagram based on newsletter stories.
* Repurpose newsletter content into social-friendly formats such as carousels, graphics, short videos or reels.
* Write captions and calls to action that encourage engagement, sharing and newsletter subscriptions.
* Maintain a consistent visual identity and tone across social media channels.
* Identify content trends and opportunities relevant to the Klang Valley audience.

3. Paid Advertising & Creative Production

* Create **3–4 paid ad creatives**, primarily for Facebook and Instagram campaigns, with formats and frequency planned together.
* Design eye-catching advertisements using Canva or similar design and editing tools.
* Develop different creative angles, headlines and copy to test what attracts the most attention and sign-ups.
* Occasionally create Instagram or Facebook Stories when suitable for campaigns, promotions or audience engagement.
* Monitor ad performance where access to campaign data is available, and suggest improvements to creatives and messaging.

4. Marketing & Audience Growth

* Suggest practical ways to grow newsletter subscriptions and improve audience engagement.
* Understand the target audience and create content that appeals to local readers.
* Help develop content and creative ideas that can attract potential sponsors.
* Support the preparation of sponsor-facing content and promotional materials.
* Work with the founder to improve the newsletter, social media presence and overall marketing strategy.

**Requirements**

* Strong English writing and editing skills.
* Comfortable researching topics and turning information into engaging content.
* Experience creating social media content for Facebook and/or Instagram.
* Proficiency in Canva or similar graphic design and video-editing tools.
* A good understanding of digital marketing, social media content and advertising creatives.
* Able to write engaging captions, headlines and advertising copy.
* Creative, organised, proactive and able to work independently.
* Willing to take ownership of projects and contribute ideas rather than simply follow instructions.
* Able to meet the Monday and Thursday newsletter deadlines consistently.

**Bonus points if you have:**

* Experience with email newsletter platforms such as Kit or ConvertKit.
* Experience with Meta Ads Manager or running Facebook and Instagram ad campaigns.
* Experience in copywriting, content marketing, audience growth or media.
* Experience developing sponsorship proposals or working with advertisers.
* An interest in local news, lifestyle, food, events and businesses around Klang Valley.

Compensation & Contract

k’LAH’ng Digest is currently an early-stage startup and has not yet begun generating revenue. This opportunity is therefore structured around **commission-based compensation rather than a guaranteed monthly salary**.

* **Commission:** 5% of each sponsorship successfully secured, subject to the agreed commission terms.
* **Initial term:** Approximately 3 months.
* **Future opportunity:** If the collaboration works well and the business grows, there is potential to continue long term, with the possibility of moving to a salaried position when financially and operationally feasible.
* **Agreement:** The initial agreement will be made between the selected candidate and the founder while the business is still being established.

The commission arrangement, what counts as a successfully secured sponsorship, when commission becomes payable, and how sponsorships are attributed will be clearly agreed in writing before work begins.

About DeepshiTech

DeepshiTech is a 360° Marketing & Tech company helping businesses build their digital presence, strengthen their brands, and achieve measurable growth through technology-driven marketing solutions.

We are looking for motivated and detail-oriented SEO Interns who are eager to learn search engine optimization and improve website visibility. This internship offers hands-on experience with real websites, keyword research, content optimization, and SEO strategies.

Roles & Responsibilities

* Conduct keyword research to identify relevant search terms and growth opportunities.
* Assist with on-page SEO activities, including title tags, meta descriptions, headings, and URL optimization.
* Support off-page SEO activities, including backlink research and link-building strategies.
* Optimize website pages, blogs, and landing pages for search engines.
* Conduct competitor analysis and research industry-specific SEO trends.
* Assist in identifying technical SEO issues such as broken links, indexing problems, and website structure concerns.
* Support local SEO activities, including Google Business Profile optimization.
* Monitor keyword rankings, website traffic, and search performance.
* Use tools such as Google Search Console, Google Analytics, and SEO research platforms to track performance.
* Prepare SEO reports and suggest improvements based on data and research.
* Collaborate with content writers and web developers to implement SEO recommendations.

Eligibility & Requirements

* Students, freshers, or recent graduates interested in SEO and digital marketing.
* Basic understanding of search engines and digital marketing concepts.
* Good research, writing, and analytical skills.
* Familiarity with keywords, website content, and basic SEO practices is preferred.
* Basic knowledge of Google Sheets or Excel.
* Familiarity with WordPress or other content management systems is an advantage.
* Attention to detail and willingness to learn new SEO tools and techniques.
* Ability to work collaboratively and meet deadlines.

**Freshers are welcome to apply.** Prior professional experience is not mandatory.

Internship Structure

The internship is designed to provide structured learning and practical exposure to SEO.

* **First 3 Months:** Training in SEO fundamentals, keyword research, on-page optimization, technical SEO basics, and SEO tools.
* **Next 3 Months:** Practical execution of SEO strategies, website optimization, content planning, and performance-based stipend opportunities.

What You Will Gain

new_jobs.description:
Senior Growth Marketing Specialist

STI Federal is seeking a mission-driven **Senior Growth Marketing Specialist** to serve as the marketing engine of our federal growth strategy. Partnering with Business Development and Capture, this role builds visibility with agencies, primes, and teaming partners and converts it into qualified pipeline.

**Who We Are & What We Do…**

At STI Federal, we drive growth through strategic government contracting, fulfilling our mission to support the Sault Ste. Marie Tribe of Chippewa Indians. Our company reinvests 100% of its profits into tribal businesses or community programs, enhancing the well-being of over 52,000 tribal citizens. Our work empowers federal agencies and strengthens some of the nation’s most critical initiatives, while fostering opportunities for skilled professionals to make a meaningful impact.

**What You’ll Do…**

**Key Responsibilities & Expected Outcomes**

**Growth Strategy & Business Development Alignment**

* Partner with Business Development and Capture leadership to build and execute an annual growth marketing plan aligned to target agencies, priority pursuits, contract vehicles, and the recompete calendar.
* Translate the opportunity pipeline into account-based campaigns aimed at specific agency program offices, contracting activities, OSDBU offices, and large-prime teaming partners.
* Position STI Federal’s tribally owned status, socioeconomic designations, and differentiators in market-facing messaging that supports set-aside, direct-award, and teaming strategies where applicable.
* Participate in BD pipeline reviews to keep marketing priorities synchronized with capture timelines.

**Conference, Trade Show & Industry Event Marketing**

* Build and manage the annual event calendar (e.g., AFCEA, NDIA, AUSA, ACT-IAC, agency industry days, OSDBU matchmaking events, and tribal business forums), recommending where to attend, exhibit, or sponsor based on pipeline alignment and expected return.
* Represent and market STI Federal at conferences, trade shows, industry days, and matchmaking sessions: staff the booth, deliver the company pitch, and initiate conversations with government buyers, prime contractors, and prospective teaming partners.
* Drive pre-event targeting: identify priority attendees, agency speakers, and exhibiting primes; secure meetings for BD and executive leadership; and run pre-show LinkedIn and email outreach.
* Capture, qualify, and log all event leads and contacts in the CRM within 48 hours of each event, and coordinate disciplined post-event follow-up with Business Development.
* Measure and report event performance (meetings secured, qualified contacts, teaming conversations initiated, and opportunities influenced) to inform future event investment decisions.

**Booth, Exhibit & Collateral Operations**

* Own end-to-end exhibit execution: registration, booth space selection, exhibitor deadlines, shipping and drayage, electrical and internet orders, and on-site setup and teardown.
* Order, design, and maintain conference booth materials and inventory, including backdrops, banners, table throws, displays, signage, lead-capture tools, and branded promotional items, in alignment with brand standards.
* Produce event-ready collateral, including capability statements, agency-specific one-pagers, contract vehicle sheets, and leave-behinds tailored to each event’s audience.
* Manage event and sponsorship budgets and vendors, and prepare booth staff with target lists and talking points so every representative engages on message.
* Ensure promotional items, hospitality, and event engagement with government personnel comply with federal ethics and gift rules.

**Capture & Proposal Marketing Support**

* Maintain the capability statement library, past performance write-ups, and company boilerplate used across capture, proposals, RFIs, and sources sought responses.
* Produce proposal graphics, win-theme visuals, and branded templates in partnership with the proposal team.

**Digital Presence & Content**

* Maintain the corporate website as an authoritative “briefing room” communicating capabilities, NAICS codes, contract vehicles, and past performance, with full ADA and Section 508 compliance.
* Translate complex technical services into mission-focused web content, capability sheets, whitepapers, newsletters, and proof points in partnership with SMEs and leadership.
* Lead the company’s LinkedIn presence and executive thought-leadership campaigns, and amplify STI Federal’s event presence before, during, and after each conference.

**Pipeline Attribution & Performance**

* Track and report marketing-sourced and marketing-influenced pipeline with BD, tying campaigns and events to opportunity outcomes.
* Route inbound agency and teaming inquiries to Business Development, and ensure no sensitive BD, capture, or nonpublic information enters public-facing materials.

**Knowledge, Skills, & Abilities for Success**

* Working knowledge of the federal acquisition lifecycle, from sources sought through award and recompete, and how marketing accelerates each stage.
* Confident, polished in-person presence; able to engage senior government officials, prime contractor executives, and small business liaisons on the conference floor.

* Strong project and vendor management skills, with a collaborative approach to working alongside BD, SMEs, and leadership.
* Proficiency with CRM platforms (e.g., Salesforce, HubSpot), CMS and analytics tools, and design tools (e.g., Adobe Creative Suite, Canva); able to convert technical concepts into clear, persuasive content.
* Demonstrates commitment to STI Federal’s core values and excels in a collaborative team environment.

**Minimum Qualifications**

**Education:**

* Bachelor’s degree in communications, Marketing, Digital Media, or related field (or equivalent experience).

**Experience:**

* 5+ years of marketing experience in a business-to-government (B2G) or federal contracting environment

**POSITION SUMMARY**

The Marketing & Media Manager is responsible for planning, coordinating, implementing, and evaluating marketing and advertising initiatives for the Deadwood Chamber of Commerce & Visitors Bureau. This position plays a key role in promoting Deadwood as a tourism destination, supporting Chamber-produced events, communicating with Chamber members, and advancing the organization’s marketing objectives.

Working under the direction of the Executive Director, the Marketing & Media Manager oversees and places paid media placement across a variety of platforms and markets, manages advertising schedules and creative deliverables, closely monitors marketing expenditures, and maintains the documentation necessary for budgeting, grant compliance, and funding reimbursement. The position requires a combination of strategic thinking, professional graphic design skills, analytical ability, project management, and attention to detail. The ability to manage several projects at once and work independently is critical.

The Manager supervises the Marketing & Communications Specialist, delegates assignments, establishes priorities, and coordinates workflows to ensure marketing projects are completed accurately, efficiently, and on schedule.

This is a hands-on position requiring the ability to develop marketing concepts, create professional advertising materials, manage media vendors and advertising agencies, analyze campaign performance, and complete projects from initial planning through final reporting. The successful candidate must be comfortable balancing creative work with administrative responsibilities, financial oversight, and event support.

The primary objectives of the Chamber’s marketing efforts are to increase visitation, occupancy, gaming revenue, and taxable sales in Deadwood; promote Chamber events and member businesses; strengthen Deadwood’s brand; share Deadwood’s history; and maximize the return on its marketing investments.

* Demonstrated experience coordinating advertising campaigns, managing deadlines, and working with media vendors or advertising agencies.

* Strong project management, organizational, and time-management skills, with the ability to manage multiple projects and competing deadlines.
* Strong written and verbal communication skills.
* Demonstrated ability to manage budgets, analyze information, code invoices and track expenditures, maintain accurate records, and manage projects within established budgets.
* Ability to supervise, mentor, delegate to, and collaborate effectively with other team members.
* Ability to interpret marketing performance data and communicate results through reports and presentations.

new_jobs.title: Director, Marketing & Communications
new_jobs.description:
Greenlight Rent, formerly Rhino + Jetty, is making housing more affordable and accessible for millions of renters each year. We're the market-leading rental housing platform building simpler, more accessible ways for people to move into homes — and for property managers to lease with confidence.

Our technology removes friction from the move-in process, lowers upfront costs for renters, and helps property managers make faster, more accurate decisions. We support a network of 3 million rental units nationwide and work with 47 of the NMHC Top 100 property owners, including Greystar, Brookfield, Asset Living, UDR, and more.

We pioneered security deposit insurance and continue to push the industry forward with a growing suite of products — from deposit management to lease guarantees and loss-of-employment protection. We're growing quickly, tackling real problems at scale, and building technology that's changing how renting works.

**The Role**

Own and evolve the Greenlight Rent brand across every channel. You'll build clear, credible materials for partners, their leasing teams, and renters while supporting revenue through sales enablement, partner marketing, and pipeline-generating campaigns.

This is a hands-on role with significant ownership and room to shape how marketing operates at Greenlight Rent. One of your first major projects will be leading the marketing website revamp, from content strategy and structure through launch.

**What You'll Own**

  

* **Brand ownership** — voice, visual identity, and consistency across every channel partners and renters touch
* **Marketing site** — own it end to end: content, structure, and a full revamp as one of the first projects in the role
* **Brand and launch communications** — announcements, email campaigns, LinkedIn, launch collateral
* **Partner marketing** — product overviews, FAQs, training materials, help-center content, rollout comms
* **Product messaging** — translate Greenlight Deposit, Greenlight Guarantee, and future products into audience-specific value props
* **Sales enablement** — modular decks, one-pagers, case-study materials, partner-specific presentations
* **Lifecycle comms** — segmented messaging across partner types, portal users, policyholders, renters; coordinate with ops/CX on readiness and inbound response
* **Content operations** — copy quality, editorial calendar, legal/compliance approvals, asset production with designers
* **Events and field marketing** — conferences and partner moments: positioning, collateral, follow-up
* **Measurement** — reporting on email performance, engagement, asset usage, marketing's contribution to pipeline

  

**First 90 Days**

* Core narrative, product messaging, and audience segmentation documented and in consistent use
* Marketing site revamp scoped, with a build plan and timeline
* Partner and renter-facing materials complete, accurate, self-serve
* Post-launch comms cadence running across email, web, portal, help center, sales, CX, events
* Revenue has a usable, modular marketing toolkit

  

**Background**

* 7+ years in B2B marketing, communications, product marketing, or brand
* Hands-on experience owning a company website — content strategy, information architecture, working directly with design/dev to ship a rebuild, not just briefing an agency
* Real estate, proptech, multifamily, or adjacent fintech/insurance experience
* Exceptional writer/editor — can turn complex product and policy detail into simple, credible copy
* Comfortable building in a small, fast-moving team with no existing marketing infrastructure
* Experience partnering closely with sales, partnerships, product, legal/compliance, CX
* Strong judgment on regulated or reputationally sensitive communications

  

**Who Thrives Here**

This is a builder role — high ownership, fast iteration, equal comfort with strategy and execution. Owns the brand outright, not just supports it. Balances a sales-forward narrative with careful coordination across legal, compliance, CX, and product. Fills the gap left by no dedicated marketing team, and makes marketing a durable counterpart to sales and product.

**This Probably Isn't the Right Fit If...**

* You need an existing marketing team or established playbook to be effective
* You haven't worked in regulated or compliance-sensitive comms before
* You want to specialize in one channel rather than own brand + comms + enablement end to end

  

**Compensation & Benefits**

**Base Salary Range:** $145,000 - $185,000

Greenlight Rent has partnered with a number of compensation benchmarking tools to determine competitive and fair market pay bands for our size and stage. Our goal is to ensure each employee is paid equitably and competitively while also maintaining a consistent and standardized methodology.

Individual pay decisions are based on a number of factors including qualifications for the role, experience level and balancing internal equity relative to other teammates.

Base salary is just one part of our Total Rewards Package here at Greenlight Rent. In connection with this position, we also offer:

  

* Competitive cash compensation package including base salary, milestone based bonus, and other financial perks
* Medical, Dental, and Vision coverage (up to 90% employer contribution) - eligible from your start date
* 401(k), HSA, Life & Disability Insurance Coverage ($0 employee contribution for additional insurances)
* Unlimited PTO Policy
* Generous Paid Parental Leave
* Stock option plan to give our employees a direct stake in R + J’s success
* Remote-first work culture with opportunities to collaborate as a team in person
* Monthly lifestyle stipend to fit your needs (meals, wellness, co-working)

new_jobs.title: Social Media & Performance Marketing Manager
new_jobs.description:
Companies: Flip It Factory & Dialed Industries

Location: Remote

Employment: Contract / Full Time

Compensation: $60,000–$75,000 base + performance-based bonus

Experience: 2+ years paid social experience; demonstrated experience managing $100K+ in monthly ad spend

About the Role

Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries are looking for a results-driven Paid Social & Performance Marketing Manager to

own and scale our Facebook and Instagram advertising. This isn't a traditional social media role. This role is responsible

for understanding that great creative gets attention and great performance marketing turns that attention into

customers, revenue and growth.

You'll take ownership of paid social strategy, campaign execution, optimization, testing and reporting across two

growing automotive brands. You'll work closely with ownership and our creative/content resources to continuously

improve performance and identify opportunities to scale.

If you live inside Meta Ads Manager, love testing creative and audiences, understand the numbers behind customer

acquisition, and get excited about figuring out why something worked, this is your role!

What You'll Own

Paid Social Strategy & Execution

 Own Facebook and Instagram paid advertising across Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries.

 Manage $100K+ in monthly advertising spend.

 Build, launch, monitor and optimize campaigns inside Meta Ads Manager.

 Develop campaign strategies around launches, giveaways, promotions and key revenue periods.

 Allocate and shift budgets based on performance and opportunity.

 Build audience, retargeting and prospecting strategies designed to efficiently acquire and convert customers.

Performance & Optimization

 Monitor performance daily and proactively identify opportunities or issues.

 Optimize toward revenue, ROAS, customer acquisition cost, conversion rate and other key business KPIs.

 Conduct structured A/B testing across creative, copy, audiences, offers, placements and campaign structures.

 Identify winning campaigns and scale them responsibly.

 Diagnose underperforming campaigns and make adjustments quickly.

Creative Strategy

 Partner with our team to identify the type of content, video, images, hooks, offers and messaging needed to

improve ad performance.

 Use campaign data to inform future creative instead of relying on guesswork.

 Continuously test new angles, messaging and formats.

 Stay current on Meta advertising trends, platform changes and emerging best practices.

Reporting & Business Insights

 Maintain clear, easy-to-understand performance reporting.

 Translate marketing data into actionable recommendations for ownership.

 Regularly report on spend, revenue, ROAS, CAC, conversion, creative performance and trends.

 Help answer the questions that matter: What's working? What's not? Why? And what should we do next?

Organic & Brand Collaboration

 Partner with our organic social/content resources so paid and organic strategies support one another.

 Identify high-performing organic content that can be leveraged through paid media.

 Help strengthen engagement and conversion across Facebook and Instagram.

 Maintain each brand's distinct voice and audience while creating efficiencies across both businesses.

 Compliance & Brand Protection

 Ensure advertising and promotional messaging aligns with platform policies and company requirements.

 Partner with leadership as needed regarding sweepstakes/giveaway promotional requirements and disclosures.

 Protect the integrity and reputation of both brands while pushing creative performance.

Requirements

 2+ years of hands-on paid social/media buying experience.

 Demonstrated experience personally managing at least $100,000 per month in paid advertising spend.

 Advanced experience with Meta Ads Manager / Meta Business Manager.

 Demonstrated ability to optimize campaigns against measurable business outcomes.

 Strong understanding of ROAS, CAC/CPA, CTR, CPM, CPC, conversion rate, attribution and funnel performance.

 Experience building prospecting and retargeting strategies.

 Strong analytical skills and comfort working with performance data.

 Experience developing and executing structured creative and campaign testing.

 Ability to work independently, move quickly and take ownership.

 Strong communication and organizational skills.

Preferences

 E-commerce or direct-to-consumer experience.

 Automotive, enthusiast, giveaway or promotional marketing experience.

 Experience with Shopify.

 GA4, pixel, conversion API and tracking knowledge.

 Experience working with video-heavy or creator-led brands.

 Experience scaling high-performing Meta campaigns.

 Knowledge of TikTok advertising or other emerging paid-social channels.

 Meta certification.

What Success Looks Like

Success isn't measured by how many posts we publish.

It's measured by whether marketing performs.

You'll be successful when you can consistently:

 Improve acquisition efficiency.

 Identify and scale winning campaigns.

 Develop a repeatable creative testing process.

 Provide clear visibility into marketing performance.

 Make smart recommendations without waiting to be asked.

 Help Flip It Factory and Dialed Industries acquire more customers and grow profitably.

The Person Who Will Thrive Here

 You're analytical without being afraid to be creative.

 You're comfortable experimenting, learning quickly and changing direction when the data tells you to.

 You don't need someone standing over your shoulder telling you what campaign to launch next.

 You see something underperforming and investigate it.

 You see something working and figure out how to scale it.

 And you're excited by the opportunity to have a direct, measurable impact on two growing automotive brands.

 Compensation: $60,000–$75,000 base salary, depending on experience, plus performance-based bonus

new_jobs.title: Social Media & Content Coordinator
new_jobs.description:
About the Role

Shasta Pools & Spas builds premium residential pools across the Valley, and every project is a story worth telling: an empty backyard on day one, a resort-style retreat at the end. We want a creator who sees those stories and can't wait to film them.

This isn't a desk job, and it isn't a role where you'll wait for assignments. You'll own Shasta's organic social presence on Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook. You'll pitch the ideas, grab your phone, head out to job sites, get our crews and homeowners talking on camera, and turn it into content people stop scrolling for. You'll have real freedom to experiment, try new formats, and jump on trends fast.

You'll also have a clear framework to work within: a weekly posting cadence and a monthly content calendar, so your creativity has a rhythm and your work shows up consistently.

What You'll Do

* Own the content from idea to post. Come up with concepts, shoot them, edit them, and publish them, with 4–5 posts per week across Instagram, TikTok, and Facebook and short-form video as the priority.
* Get out in the field. Visit construction sites, finished backyards, showrooms, and company events to capture authentic content. Most weeks you'll spend more time on location than at a desk.
* Get people talking on camera. Interview homeowners about their new backyard, get our builders and service techs to share what they know, and capture the personalities behind the brand.
* Tell the transformation story. Before-and-afters, dig-day-to-first-swim timelines, behind-the-scenes moments, customer experiences, and company culture.
* Move fast on trends. Spot new formats, sounds, and ideas as they emerge and turn them into Shasta content while they're still relevant.
* Shoot and edit short-form video on a smartphone or camera, using CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools, with strong hooks, pacing, and captions.
* Capture great photos of premium projects and outdoor lifestyle moments, with an eye for composition, lighting, and making a backyard look like a destination.
* Create graphics and promo creative in Canva, Adobe, or AI-assisted design tools for social posts, promotions, flyers, and brochures.
* Write scroll-stopping captions, hooks, and calls to action, plus basic promotional copy.
* Keep the calendar on track. Build a monthly content calendar around seasonal demand, promotions, and company announcements, and hit the posting cadence every week.
* Learn from the numbers. Watch reach, engagement, video retention, and follower growth, and share a quick monthly recap of what worked and what you'll try next.
* Pitch in on marketing projects. Help with creative requests from sales, keep marketing materials and the photo and video library organized, and coordinate with outside vendors.
* Keep it unmistakably Shasta. Make sure everything you publish reflects our premium brand, look, and voice.

You're Probably a Great Fit If You…

* Always have a new content idea and get restless when you're not creating something.
* Light up around people. You can walk onto a job site, make a crew laugh, and get a homeowner comfortable on camera in a few minutes.
* Like to move fast and would rather post something good today than something perfect next month.
* Want ownership. You do your best work when someone hands you the goal and trusts you to figure out how to get there.
* Can keep yourself on a schedule. Your creativity is backed by a track record of posting consistently.

What You Bring

* 1–3 years of experience creating organic social content, through a job, internship, freelance work, or growing your own account. Recent grads with a strong portfolio are encouraged to apply.
* A portfolio of short-form video you conceived, shot, and edited yourself. This is the most important part of your application.
* A posting history that shows consistency, whether on a brand account you ran or your own, over at least several months.
* Fluency on TikTok, Instagram, and Facebook, including Reels, Stories, carousels, and what's working on each platform right now.
* Hands-on editing skills in CapCut, Adobe Premiere Pro, or similar tools.
* A strong visual eye for photography, lighting, and aesthetics.
* Sharp, engaging writing for captions, hooks, and calls to action.

Nice to Have

* Content experience in home improvement, construction, outdoor living, luxury lifestyle, or another visually driven consumer brand.
* Comfort using AI-assisted creative tools (Canva Magic Studio, Adobe Firefly, CapCut AI features, ChatGPT or Claude) to speed up ideation, editing, and design.
* Experience with social scheduling and analytics platforms.
* Experience coordinating influencer partnerships, user-generated content, or customer testimonials.
* Basic familiarity with email marketing, content management systems, or general digital marketing.

Field & Schedule Requirements

* Valid driver's license and reliable vehicle; mileage reimbursed for travel to job sites across the Phoenix metro area.
* Comfortable working outdoors, including Arizona summer heat.
* Able to follow safety rules on active construction sites.
* Occasional early-morning, evening, or weekend shoots for events and the best light.

Not Part of This Role

To keep your focus on creating, this role does not include:

* Website development or maintenance.
* Advanced SEO or technical website optimization.
* Managing Google Ads or Meta paid campaigns.
* Advanced marketing automation, CRM administration, or analytics implementation

Send your resume to ShastaHR@shastapools.com and a link to your portfolio or the account you've been growing. Include at least three short-form videos you shot and edited yourself. Then tell us, in a sentence or two, the first video you'd make at Shasta. Finalists will complete a short paid editing exercise using raw footage from one of our projects.

new_jobs.title: Paid Media Specialist (Part-Time)
new_jobs.description:
UTTR is looking for a **part-time Paid Media Specialist** with 3–5 years of experience to manage, optimise, and grow paid digital marketing campaigns across multiple B2B client accounts.

You’ll work with B2B SaaS and technology companies, managing campaigns across platforms such as LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other relevant channels. You’ll collaborate with campaign managers, designers, RevOps specialists, and clients to ensure paid media activity drives meaningful business results.

We’re looking for someone who is analytical, proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable taking ownership of campaigns from strategy and setup through optimisation and reporting.

**What You'll Be Doing**
------------------------

### **Campaign Management**

* Manage paid media campaigns across LinkedIn Ads, Google Ads, Microsoft Ads, Meta, and other relevant platforms.
* Plan and execute campaign launches, including targeting, budgets, bidding, tracking, and creative coordination.
* Manage multiple client accounts and ensure campaigns are delivered on time and aligned with business goals.
* Monitor campaign performance, budget pacing, and delivery, proactively identifying and resolving issues.
* Develop and implement paid media strategies based on client objectives and target audiences.

### **Performance & Optimisation**

* Analyse campaign performance and turn data into actionable recommendations.
* Optimise campaigns across audiences, creatives, bidding strategies, budgets, keywords, and landing pages.
* Plan and manage A/B tests across audiences, messaging, creative, and landing pages.
* Track key metrics such as CPL, CPA, CTR, CPC, conversion rates, and pipeline contribution.
* Identify trends and opportunities to improve campaign efficiency and performance.

### **Analytics & Reporting**

* Use HubSpot, CRM platforms, GA4, and advertising platforms to analyse campaign performance.
* Connect paid media results with leads, pipeline, and broader business outcomes.
* Build and maintain campaign reports and dashboards for internal teams and clients.
* Communicate performance insights, challenges, and recommendations clearly.
* Use Looker Studio or similar reporting tools where applicable.

### **Collaboration**

* Work closely with designers, RevOps specialists, campaign managers, and clients.
* Participate in client meetings and communicate campaign performance and recommendations.
* Stay up to date with advertising platform changes and paid media best practices.
* Proactively identify opportunities to improve account and campaign performance.

**What You'll Bring**
---------------------

* 3–5 years of hands-on paid media experience, ideally in an agency or B2B marketing environment.
* Strong experience with one or more platforms such as Google Ads, LinkedIn Ads, Meta, or Microsoft Ads.
* Experience managing campaign budgets and making data-driven optimisation decisions.
* Strong understanding of paid media fundamentals, targeting, bidding, conversion tracking, and attribution.
* Experience with GA4, HubSpot, CRM platforms, or similar marketing technology.
* Strong analytical, problem-solving, and organisational skills.
* Excellent written and verbal communication skills.
* Ability to manage multiple campaigns and priorities independently.
* Comfortable working cross-functionally and directly with clients.
* Proactive mindset and strong attention to detail.
* Advanced English (C1).

You don't need to have experience with every platform listed above. We're looking for someone with a strong paid media foundation who can confidently manage campaigns and continue developing their expertise across channels.

**Nice to Have**
----------------

* Google Ads, Meta, or LinkedIn certifications.
* Experience working with B2B SaaS or technology companies.
* Experience with Looker Studio or other reporting tools.
* Familiarity with attribution tools or B2B marketing technology.
* Experience connecting paid media performance to pipeline and revenue.
* Experience presenting campaign performance directly to clients.

**Working Hours**
-----------------

This is a **part-time, fully remote role** with working hours agreed upon in advance.

We're fully remote, and you can work from anywhere. However, you'll need consistent overlap with EST, CST, MST, or PST business hours for team collaboration and occasional client meetings.

**Why Work at UTTR?**
---------------------

* **Global flexibility:** Work from anywhere as part of a fully remote team.
* **Cultural diversity:** Work with a diverse, globally distributed team.
* **Diverse tech clients:** Work with a variety of startups and technology companies.
* **Grow your expertise:** Manage real B2B campaigns and deepen your skills across paid media, analytics, and performance marketing.

*Please be aware that legitimate UTTR recruitment communications will come from an* ***@uttr.com*** *email address. Any offers or candidate interviews originating from other email domains should be treated as potential phishing attempts and do not represent UTTR LLC.*

*If you are ever unsure about the legitimacy of a communication, please contact UTTR directly.*

This role requires someone who can move between strategy and execution, build a consistent testing cadence, and use data to make decisions about where to invest. * Build and optimize AI agent workflows, sequences, dashboards, and queries to automate repetitive work and improve execution
* Maintain a consistent experiment log, communicate results, and use performance data to guide future investments

**What You Bring**
------------------

* 4 to 6 years of experience in growth marketing or demand generation, including at least 2 years directly owning a lead or pipeline target
* A data-driven approach to decision-making, with the ability to build reports, write queries, analyze funnel performance, and distinguish meaningful signals from noise
* A strong experimentation mindset. You test frequently, learn quickly, and know when to stop investing in underperforming campaigns
* Hands-on experience with HubSpot and paid acquisition platforms such as Google, Meta, and LinkedIn
* Experience improving conversion across the marketing funnel, from initial engagement through booked and held meetings

**Nice To Have**
----------------

* Experience marketing to automotive dealerships or another vertical where individual accounts represent significant business value
* Experience running partner or channel marketing programs
* Working knowledge of answer engine optimization (AEO)

**What Success Looks Like**
---------------------------

* Consistently grow qualified inbound quarter over quarter while maintaining lead quality and Sales' confidence in the pipeline
* Increase the percentage of booked meetings that become held meetings
* Maintain accurate funnel reporting and attribution that aligns with CRM data
* Establish a steady cadence of experiments that produce clear learnings and measurable conversion improvements
* Build scalable growth programs and AI-powered workflows that improve marketing efficiency

**Why Join Numa**
-----------------

* We believe in everyone's growth
* Be part of an industry leader named the #1 fastest-growing AI Automotive company by Inc. 5000
* Help bring category-defining AI technology to an industry undergoing significant change
* Join a high-growth organization with opportunities to make a meaningful impact and grow your career

**Compensation & Benefits**

**About the role**

We operate five car dealerships across Ohio and we're hiring one person to own our entire digital presence — websites, social media, paid advertising, and content — for all five stores. This is not an agency-liaison job. You will build, post, run, and measure it yourself, and you'll report directly to ownership.

You'll be on the lot with a phone in your hand as much as you're at a desk. If you've never shot a walkaround video of a used truck and turned it into a lead, this isn't the job.

**What you'll do**

- Own paid digital for 5 rooftops: Meta/Instagram ads, Google Ads (search, PMax, VLA), YouTube, TikTok — budgets, targeting, creative, reporting  
- Shoot and edit short-form video and photo content on-site at each store (inventory features, staff, customer deliveries, promotions)  
- Run every social account for every store — daily posting, comments, DMs, reviews  
- Manage dealership websites and inventory merchandising (photos, descriptions, pricing displays, specials pages)  
- Build and run email/SMS campaigns to our customer database (service, equity mining, sales events)  
- Manage the Google Business Profiles and online reputation for all five locations  
- Report monthly to ownership: spend, cost per lead, leads by store and source, what's working, what you killed  
- Plan and promote sales events and staffed events with the GMs

**What you must have**

- 3+ years of digital marketing **inside automotive** — dealership, dealer group, or an automotive-only agency. Non-automotive applicants will not be considered.  
- Hands-on experience running Meta Ads Manager and Google Ads yourself (not just briefing a vendor)  
- A portfolio of content you personally shot and edited — video and photo  
- Working knowledge of dealer website platforms (Dealer.com, DealerOn, Dealer Inspire, or similar) and inventory feed tools  
- Familiarity with dealership CRMs (VinSolutions, DealerSocket, eLead, etc.) and how leads route  
- Comfortable with Canva, CapCut, Adobe, or equivalent; able to turn around a post the same day  
- Valid driver's license and reliable transportation — you'll travel between our stores weekly

**Nice to have**

- Experience with OEM co-op advertising programs and compliance  
- Livestreaming or on-camera experience  
- Experience building a dealership brand from scratch or turning around a store with no digital presence

**How to apply**

Apply through Indeed with your resume **and links to 3 pieces of automotive content you made yourself** (ad, video, or social account you ran). Applications without work samples won't be reviewed.

**Or skip the line: text Gavin at 276-220-6798.** Send your name, your current/last dealership, and a link to one piece of content you made. Fastest way to get a reply.

The SEO Copywriter, Medical Aesthetics is the writer behind the content that helps Bios' clinics across North America connect with patients and grow. This role writes short-form video scripts, carousels, social captions, emails, ad copy and website pages, with SEO built into every piece so each clinic stands out in search, on social platforms and in AI search tools.

In a regulated industry, accuracy matters. The SEO Copywriter turns complex information about a wide range of treatments into clear, compliant copy that follows the advertising rules of each province or state where our clinics operate.

Working in Monday.com, Klaviyo, WordPress, SEMrush and all major social platforms, this role plans, writes and optimizes content for several clinics at once, keeping each one true to its own voice. The result is a stronger online presence for every clinic, more patients through the door and lasting trust built on reliable information.

**KEY RESPONSIBILITIES**

**Social Content Scripts and Carousels**

* Write scripts for Reels, TikToks, YouTube Shorts and Stories: a hook in the first 1 to 3 seconds, talking points or voiceover, on-screen text, suggested shots and a call to action.
* Write scripts practitioners and content creators can deliver naturally on camera, in simple language with room for their own personality.
* Write carousel copy slide by slide (usually 5 to 10 slides) explaining a treatment, skin concern, myth or process, with direction for designers on each slide.
* Build repeatable series, such as “how it works,” “myth vs. fact” and “what to expect,” that work across clinics and treatments.
* Adapt one core idea for several clinics so each version fits that clinic’s voice, treatment menu and community without sounding copied.

**Captions and Social SEO**

* Write captions for Instagram, TikTok, Facebook and YouTube with natural keywords, treatment names, concerns and local place names so posts show up in platform search.
* Tailor captions to each platform: length, format, hashtags, alt text and first comments.
* Keep an up-to-date keyword and hashtag list for each clinic and treatment.
* Include a clear next step in every caption, such as booking a consultation or visiting the website.

**Email Marketing**

* Write educational and promotional emails for each clinic in Klaviyo: subject lines, preview text, body copy and calls to action.
* Write and maintain automated flows: welcome series, consultation follow-up, pre- and post-treatment education, reminders, memberships, reactivation and win-back.
* Brief designers on layout, images and the order of content blocks.
* Run subject line and content tests and report on what drives bookings and website visits.
* Make sure every email meets anti-spam law for its audience: CASL in Canada and CAN-SPAM in the US.

**Ad Copy**

* Write ad copy for paid social and search campaigns with the paid media team: headlines, primary text, descriptions and calls to action.
* Write variations for testing and make sure each ad’s message matches its landing page.
* Follow each platform’s health and cosmetic advertising policies (Meta, Google, TikTok) as well as the rules for each jurisdiction.

**Website Copy**

* Write and update treatment pages, concern pages, clinic location pages, practitioner bios, FAQs, landing pages and educational articles.
* Balance education and conversion: how the treatment works, who it suits, what to expect, recovery, how long results last and the next step.
* Rewrite competitor or manufacturer material into original copy in each clinic’s voice, never copying it.
* Keep pages accurate when services, devices, products or practitioners change.

**SEO (on-page and content)**

* Do keyword research for each clinic’s market: treatment, concern, local (for example, “lip filler Kelowna”) and question-based searches.
* Map keywords to pages so pages don’t compete with each other and find gaps where new pages are needed.
* Own on-page SEO: title tags, meta descriptions, headings, URL suggestions, internal links, alt text and FAQ sections.
* Write local SEO content for each clinic, including location pages and Google Business Profile descriptions and posts.
* Write content that answers questions directly so it can appear in AI search tools and Google’s AI Overviews.
* Give the web developer content for structured data (FAQs, services, locations, practitioners) and flag technical issues like broken links or duplicate pages.
* Track rankings, traffic and click-through rates in Google Search Console and SEMrush. Run regular content audits

new_jobs.title: Head of Growth Marketing
new_jobs.description:
**ABOUT SLATE**

At Slate, we’re building safe, reliable vehicles that people can afford, personalize and love—and doing it here in the USA as part of our commitment to reindustrialization. The spirit of DIY and customization runs throughout every element of a Slate, because people should have control over how their trucks look, feel, and represent them.

**| WHO WE ARE LOOKING FOR**

Slate sells direct to consumer. Every truck is reserved, designed, purchased and accessorized through channels we own: our website, vehicle configurator, online marketplace and app. That puts growth at the center of how Slate operates.

We’re looking for a Head of Growth to own the full customer funnel: from first visit to reservation, from reservation to order and delivery, and from delivery to accessories, wraps and referrals. Reporting to the Head of Marketing, you will lead performance marketing, lifecycle and CRM, conversion optimization and marketing analytics. You’ll be accountable for the numbers that matter most as Slate moves into its first customer deliveries and beyond: reservation-to-order conversion, customer acquisition cost, accessory attach rate and payback.

The ideal candidate has built and scaled growth for a direct-to-consumer brand with a considered purchase. You are as comfortable in a media plan as you are in an experiment readout or a funnel query, and you run a team that is fast, frugal and scrappy with every dollar.

**| WHAT YOU GET TO DO**

Growth Strategy & Ownership

* Own Slate’s growth strategy and targets across the customer lifecycle: awareness to order, order to delivery, and post-purchase accessories, wraps, service, loyalty, retention and referral.

* Build and maintain the growth model and forecast in partnership with Finance; set targets for volume, CAC, conversion and payback, and report against them every week.

* Own the paid media and growth budget, moving spend quickly toward what works and away from what doesn’t.

* Partner with the Head of Marketing to turn brand and launch plans into measurable demand programs, and represent growth performance in leadership reviews.

Acquisition

* Lead paid acquisition across search, direct, paid social, online video and CTV, programmatic, affiliate and emerging channels, with in-house and agency partners.

* Build launch and regional demand plans that match vehicle availability, SI&OP, delivery geography and Slate’s regional service and wrap installation network.

* Work with PR, Influencer and Brand teams to turn earned media, creator content, events and owner community into measurable acquisition.

* Design and launch referral and owner-advocacy programs that make Slate owners part of the growth engine.

* Partner with Fleet Sales on demand generation for small business and commercial fleet buyers.

Lifecycle, CRM & Retention

* Own lifecycle marketing across email, SMS, push and in-app, guiding reservation holders through configuration, financing, order and delivery.

* Grow post-purchase revenue through accessory, wrap and merchandise programs timed to the ownership journey.

* Build audience segmentation and personalized journeys in Salesforce Marketing Cloud.

Conversion & Experimentation

* Own the experimentation program across the website, configurator, reservation and checkout flows, with clear hypotheses, success metrics and guardrails.

* Partner with Digital Experience Design, Product and Engineering to prioritize the funnel improvements with the largest impact on conversion.

* Lead the CRO function, including test implementation, tooling and site performance during testing.

* Work with eCommerce Merchandising to improve accessory discovery and attach rate across the marketplace.

Measurement & Analytics

* Evolve a growth measurement stack leadership trusts: attribution, incrementality testing, media mix modeling and funnel dashboards.

* Define north-star and channel-level growth metrics, and keep data definitions consistent across Marketing, Sales, Product and Finance.

* Use AI and automation to speed up analysis, creative testing, demand projections, forecasting, demand modeling, and campaign operations.

Team Building & Leadership

* Lead and develop a team spanning performance marketing, lifecycle and CRM, CRO and marketing analytics, hiring to fill capability gaps as Slate scales.

* Select and manage agency, ad tech and martech partners with clear scopes, service levels and cost discipline.

Build a team culture of curiosity, speed and direct feedback, grounded in data and customer insight.  



**| WHAT YOU BRING TO THE TEAM**

Required

* 12+ years of experience in growth, performance or lifecycle marketing, including at least 5 years leading teams, with experience managing managers or leads.

* A track record of scaling a direct-to-consumer business with a high-consideration purchase (automotive, EV, consumer hardware, mobility, home or financial products), with results you can quantify.

* Hands-on ownership of a full-funnel growth model with budget accountability, including CAC, conversion, LTV and payback.

* Deep expertise in paid acquisition across major platforms, along with lifecycle and CRM program design.

* Experience running a disciplined experimentation program, with a working command of test design, statistical significance and incrementality.

* Strong analytical skills; comfortable working directly in GA4, Looker or similar BI tools, and in SQL or alongside analysts at the query level.

* Experience with Salesforce Marketing Cloud or a comparable ESP, CRM and CDP stack.

* Clear, structured writing and communication, with the ability to present plans and results to executive leadership.

* Bachelor’s degree in Marketing, Business, Economics, Statistics or a related field, or equivalent professional experience.

Preferred

* Experience leading growth through a major product launch, ideally from pre-order or reservations through first deliveries.

* Automotive, EV or direct-to-consumer

**Director, Paid Marketing & MarTech**

**The Opportunity**

Every paid dollar EcoShield spends to acquire a customer will run through you. This is the senior operator seat for all paid customer acquisition: you will own the strategy, the execution, and the P&L for every paid channel, manage an annual working media budget (with a focus on driving marketing attributed revenue at an acceptable CAC), and own the marketing technology stack that powers the entire engine. You will be hands-on in the work while we grow the program and hire the team, building and optimizing campaigns yourself in the early innings. Your channels feed a National Inside Sales organization, so you will own paid media's contribution to marketing attributed revenue which is driven by qualified lead volume, connected leads, sales, and blended CAC.

**What You Will Own**

* Strategy, execution, and P&L for all paid channels: paid search, paid social, display and video, Local Services Ads, retargeting, direct mail testing, etc.
* An annual working media budget scaling into eight figures, deployed against clear CAC, ROAS, and lead volume targets by channel.
* The MarTech stack and team end-to-end: evaluating, selecting, negotiating, and implementing platforms across tag management, web analytics, call tracking and conversation intelligence, experimentation, and marketing automation. You will partner with the CMO and other Marketing and Analytics leaders to build out this program.
* Measurement design in partnership with the Director, Marketing Data & Analytics: offline conversion feeds, value-based bidding, and incrementality testing so ad platforms optimize toward sold subscriptions rather than simply raw lead volume.
* Lifecycle marketing: email and SMS nurture programs covering speed to lead, failed dial revival, and aged lead win back, run on a modern automation platform.
* Team and partner leadership: as we grow the program, you will hire and develop paid media and lifecycle specialists and manage agency and vendor relationships if/where they genuinely add value.
* Daily partnership with National Inside Sales on speed to lead, lead quality feedback loops.
* Creative testing velocity: briefs, ad copy, landing page variants, and offer tests in partnership with CRO.
* Forecasting and reporting: paid lead and sales volume forecasts, with weekly performance reporting on spend, CAC, and ROAS.

**What You Will Bring**

Required

* 4+ years in affiliate or partner marketing, with direct hands-on responsibility for a program's results.
* Demonstrated experience building or substantially scaling an affiliate program, ideally from scratch or from a basic state.
* Hands-on platform fluency with one or more major affiliate networks or SaaS platforms (Impact, Commission Junction, Awin, Partnerize, ShareASale, Rakuten Advertising, Everflow, or similar).

* Self-starting, highly responsive, and trustworthy. You will be the face of EcoShield to outside partners and will operate with real autonomy.

Preferred

* Experience in a marketing organization that drives leads for an inside sales call center.
* Home services, subscription, and/or local services category experience.
* Familiarity with call tracking platforms and offline conversion feeds.
* Experience managing affiliate compliance and fraud prevention at scale.

Straight talk about what this is. We are building a lead generation and online customer acquisition engine from the ground up, in an industry that has never seen one built this well. The pace will be fast, team culture will be one of winning and collaboration, and the celebrations will be exciting as we grow and hit our targets. That is exactly what makes it fun.

* You build, you do not maintain. Your fingerprints will be on something that did not exist before you showed up.
* Real budget, real backing. Direct line to a fully committed CMO and executive team.
* Outcomes over activity. You will be measured on what you actually produce, and when it works, everyone will know exactly who built it.
* It will ask a lot of you. This is not a coasting seat. The people who lean all the way in will look back on this as the most career defining work they have done.

If you want to manage an established program with partners already in place, this is not the seat. If you want to build a channel from zero and own what it becomes, this is the place for you!

The Shield Co. Management / EcoShield Pest Solutions is one of the fastest-growing pest control companies in the country! Our mission is to create the world’s happiest family, and our purpose is to spread happiness. We do this by delivering exceptional experiences to our customers, employees, partners, and communities—treating everyone like family.

**About Marketing.Storage**

Marketing.Storage is a digital marketing and technology company built exclusively for the self storage industry. We partner with storage operators to drive more rentals, revenue, and ROI through digital marketing, website strategy, reporting, and technology built for storage. With 16+ years and 4,000+ facilities behind our data, we take the guesswork out of marketing.

We are a remote team that runs on high trust and high accountability. We expect a lot, we support each other, and we make room for the good parts of team life along the way. If you are an owner who thrives on driving work to the finish, you will fit right in.

**The Role**

We are looking for a Brand and Growth Marketing Manager to own our brand and drive our own growth. You will work directly with our leadership and sales team on two connected fronts: keeping the Marketing.Storage brand consistent, organized, and strong, and leading the lead generation efforts that grow the business.

This role is about ownership. You will manage the work, set priorities, direct internal team members and outside partners, and make sure important brand and growth work gets planned, executed, and followed through. You will not execute every tactical task yourself. Our internal fulfillment team handles the hands-on marketing execution, so experience in SEO or paid ads is a plus but not required. What matters most is that you can own outcomes and keep momentum.

**Brand management**
